description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Rendclaw Trow
When Rendclaw Trow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Rendclaw Trow enters, Stalwart Successor triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Rendclaw Trow
Repeat.
